message.content:
viscous friction depends on relative velocity and a damping coefficient.
coefficient quantifies the medium's resistance to flow.
flow losses should be included when the pendulum swings in a fluid or has viscous pivot friction.
friction damping matters if the amplitude decays noticeably.
noticeably damped motion means the physical pendulum model should include a viscous torque.
